Two ways to shrink a model. Quantization.src:
Two ways to shrink a model. Quantization reduces bit-width
          per weight; pruning zeroes weights out entirely. Slide
          both, see accuracy hold, then crack at predictable
          thresholds.

where $s$ is the scale and $z$ the zero-.zh:
其中 $s$ 为缩放因子，$z$ 为零点。反量化：
          $\hat x = s \cdot (q - z)$。每个元素的往返误差
          均匀分布于 $[-s/2, s/2]$，方差为 $s^2 /
          12$。位宽减半意味着 $\log_2(\text{level})$ 减半 —
          因此每减少一位可节省 $\sim$1 倍内存，并增加 $\sim$6 dB 的
          量化噪声。
where $s$ is the scale and $z$ the zero-.src:
where $s$ is the scale and $z$ the zero-point. Dequantisation:
          $\hat x = s \cdot (q - z)$. Round-trip error per element is
          uniformly distributed in $[-s/2, s/2]$, with variance $s^2 /
          12$. Halving the bit-width halves $\log_2(\text{levels})$ —
          so each bit saves $\sim$1× memory and adds $\sim$6 dB of
          quantisation noise.

Two practical choices that matter more t.zh: 两个实际选择，其重要性超出其表面所述：
Two practical choices that matter more t.src: Two practical choices that matter more than they sound:

@@T0@@Symmetric vs asymmetric.@@T1@@ Sym.zh:
@@T0@@对称 vs 非对称。@@T1@@ 对称量化强制
            $z = 0$，故 $\hat x = sq$ — 每次乘法可省去一次减法，
            代价是当 $x$ 单侧分布时（如 ReLU 激活）
            浪费一半的取值范围。多数权重量化器是
            对称的；许多激活量化器则是非对称的。
@@T0@@Symmetric vs asymmetric.@@T1@@ Sym.src: Symmetric vs asymmetric. Symmetric forces $z = 0$, so $\hat x = sq$ — saves a subtraction per multiply, at the cost of wasting half the range when $x$ is one-sided (e.g. ReLU activations). Most weight quantisers are symmetric; many activation quantisers are asymmetric.

@@T0@@Per-tensor vs per-channel.@@T1@@ P.zh:
@@T0@@逐张量 vs 逐通道。@@T1@@ 逐张量对整个权重矩阵
            使用同一个 $s$；逐通道则为每个输出通道使用一个
            $s_c$。逐通道在推理时不增加额外代价
            （缩放因子可并入偏置），对于跨通道动态范围较大的
            矩阵而言不可或缺。2024 年以来已是各处的默认做法。
@@T0@@Per-tensor vs per-channel.@@T1@@ P.src: Per-tensor vs per-channel. Per-tensor uses one $s$ for the whole weight matrix; per-channel uses one $s_c$ per output channel. Per-channel costs nothing extra at inference (the scale folds into the bias) and is essential for matrices with wide cross-channel dynamic range. Default everywhere in 2024+.

@@T0@@Outliers.@@T1@@ A single 100× outl.zh:
@@T0@@离群值。@@T1@@ 单个 100 倍于常态的权重
            就会拉大取值范围，压垮其余所有
            权重的分辨率。逐通道量化对权重隐藏了这一问题；
            而 @@T2@@激活@@T3@@ 的离群值（大语言模型中某个很大的
            注意力头）正是 SmoothQuant 存在的原因。
@@T0@@Outliers.@@T1@@ A single 100× outl.src: Outliers. A single 100× outlier weight stretches the range and crushes the resolution of all other weights. Per-channel hides this for weights; activation outliers (one large attention head in an LLM) are why SmoothQuant exists.

GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant — the LLM quantis.zh: GPTQ、AWQ、SmoothQuant — 大语言模型量化一族
GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant — the LLM quantis.src: GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant — the LLM quantisation family

Naively running PTQ on a 70B LLM at int4.zh: 对 700 亿参数的大语言模型以 int4 朴素运行 PTQ 会彻底摧毁精度。有三种技术可挽回其中大部分；它们都是训练后方法，都以校准为驱动（使用数百条无标注提示词），并且都已内置在流行的运行时中。
Naively running PTQ on a 70B LLM at int4.src: Naively running PTQ on a 70B LLM at int4 obliterates accuracy. Three techniques restore most of it; all are post-training, all are calibration-driven (use a few hundred unlabelled prompts), and all ship in popular runtimes.

@@T0@@GPTQ@@T1@@ (Frantar et&nbsp;al., 2.zh:
@@T0@@GPTQ@@T1@@（Frantar 等人，2022）。逐列量化权重矩阵，
            并通过 Hessian 更新将残差误差传播到其余（仍为浮点的）列中。
            其思路与最优脑量化（OBQ）相近。可在单张 GPU 上于数小时内
            将 700 亿参数模型量化为 int4；int4 下的困惑度接近 FP16。
@@T0@@GPTQ@@T1@@ (Frantar et&nbsp;al., 2.src: GPTQ (Frantar et al., 2022). Quantise columns of a weight matrix one at a time, propagating the residual error into the remaining (still-float) columns via a Hessian update. Close in spirit to Optimal Brain Quantisation. Quantises a 70B model to int4 in a few hours on one GPU; near-FP16 perplexity at int4.

@@T0@@AWQ@@T1@@ (Lin et&nbsp;al., 2023)..zh:
@@T0@@AWQ@@T1@@（Lin 等人，2023）。在量化 @@T2@@之前@@T3@@ 先对权重与激活进行缩放，
            使最“显著”的权重（即那些与大数值激活相互作用的权重）获得更高的分辨率。
            比 GPTQ 更廉价；对于 int4 大语言模型常能与之持平或更优。
@@T0@@AWQ@@T1@@ (Lin et&nbsp;al., 2023)..src: AWQ (Lin et al., 2023). Scale weights and activations before quantising so the most "salient" weights (those interacting with large-magnitude activations) get more resolution. Cheaper than GPTQ; often matches or beats it for int4 LLMs.

@@T0@@SmoothQuant@@T1@@ (Xiao et&nbsp;al.zh:
@@T0@@SmoothQuant@@T1@@（Xiao 等人，2022）。将量化的难度
            从激活迁移到权重 — 权重乘以 $s$，激活除以 $s$，
            计算等价，但量化表现大为改善。它是
            针对激活离群值所致失效的修复方案。
@@T0@@SmoothQuant@@T1@@ (Xiao et&nbsp;al.src: SmoothQuant (Xiao et al., 2022). Migrates the quantisation difficulty from activations to weights — multiply weights by $s$, divide activations by $s$, equivalent computation, much better quantisation behaviour. The fix for activation-outlier-driven failures.

@@T0@@K/V cache quantisation.@@T1@@ Beyo.zh:
@@T0@@K/V 缓存量化。@@T1@@ 除权重之外，KV 缓存在长上下文下

            vLLM、llama.cpp 的默认做法；FP8 K/V 自 2025 年起开始出现。
@@T0@@K/V cache quantisation.@@T1@@ Beyo.src: K/V cache quantisation. Beyond weights, the KV cache dominates LLM memory at long context. INT8 K/V cache is now a default in vLLM, llama.cpp; FP8 K/V is appearing in 2025+.

@@T0@@The 2026 LLM quantisation recipe.@.zh:
@@T0@@2026 年的大语言模型量化方案。@@T1@@
          用于推理：@@T2@@权重经 AWQ 或 GPTQ 量化为 int4，激活经 SmoothQuant 量化为 int8，K/V 缓存为 int8@@T3@@。总计：相对于 fp16 显存减少约 4 倍，而在多数 7B–70B 对话模型上困惑度损失 < 1%。
@@T0@@The 2026 LLM quantisation recipe.@.src: The 2026 LLM quantisation recipe. For inference: weights at int4 via AWQ or GPTQ, activations at int8 via SmoothQuant, K/V cache at int8. Total: ~4× memory reduction vs fp16 with < 1% perplexity hit on most 7B–70B chat models.

@@T0@@What it tells us.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@它告诉了我们什么。@@T1@@
          训练好的网络中大多数权重并未被使用；剪枝

          — 随机初始化加剪枝会失败；匹配的初始化加

@@T0@@What it tells us.@@T1@@\n.src: What it tells us. Most weights in a trained network are unused; pruning finds the useful subset. Initialization matters — random init plus pruning fails; matched init plus pruning succeeds. This is a clue to the implicit bias of SGD that mainstream theory still hasn't fully explained.

Unstructured 90% sparsity rarely speeds.zh: 非结构化 90% 稀疏在 GPU 上很少能加速推理 — 稠密的矩阵乘法核仍会在这些零上运行。有两种硬件真正喜欢的模式：
Unstructured 90% sparsity rarely speeds.src: Unstructured 90% sparsity rarely speeds up inference on a GPU — the dense matmul kernel still runs over the zeros. Two patterns the hardware actually likes:

@@T0@@2:4 sparsity.@@T1@@ NVIDIA Ampere+.zh:
@@T0@@2:4 稀疏。@@T1@@ NVIDIA Ampere 及之后的架构支持
            硬件加速的 2:4 结构化稀疏：每 4 个连续权重中
            至多有 2 个非零。在微调后无精度损失的前提下，
            有效稀疏度为 50%，加速约 2 倍。现已成为生产推理的默认做法。
@@T0@@2:4 sparsity.@@T1@@ NVIDIA Ampere+.src: 2:4 sparsity. NVIDIA Ampere+ supports a hardware-accelerated 2:4 structured sparsity: every group of 4 consecutive weights has at most 2 non-zero. Effective 50% sparsity with ~2× speed-up at no accuracy loss after fine-tune. Now the default for production inference.

meta.title: 量化与剪枝：并排对比
meta.tagline: 将模型压缩至 int8 / int4 / 稀疏 — 并精确观察精度在何处跌落悬崖
meta.summary: 在二维分类玩具任务上运行的实时网络：将量化位宽从 16 滑至 1，剪枝比例从 0% 滑至 95%。观察精度随模型大小的变化。随后逐一讲解 PTQ、QAT 与彩票假说，并说明每种技术的合理代价与收益。
highlights: 训练一个小型 MLP；用量化滑块从 FP16 一直滑到 1 位权重；给出每个位宽下的精度。
幅值剪枝比例滑块；观察决策边界仅在稀疏度超过约 80% 后才开始崩塌。
大小-精度曲线，标注出 PTQ、QAT 与结构化剪枝的位置。
彩票假说面板：剪枝 + 重置 + 重训练；观察子网络训练得与原始网络一样好。
